device.note: Abracon datasheets/osc/ASEM.pdf: plastic 3.2 x 2.5 x 0.85 mm MEMS clock oscillator, CMOS output (15 pF). p.1: frequency range 1.0-150 MHz. p.3 Options and Part Identification: ASEM1 = supply 3.3 +-0.3 V (codes 2-5 are the 3.0, 2.5, 1.8 and 2.8 V options, not in the library); -LC = -40 to +85 C, +-50 ppm; -T = reel. p.4: pins 1 Standby, 2 GND, 3 Output, 4 Vdd. p.2 Tri-state Function (Stand-by): pin 1 low (below 0.25 Vdd) = output Hi Z; high or open = output active.

Abracon datasheets/osc/ASEseries.pdf: 3.3 V CMOS compatible 3.2 x 2.5 x 1.2 mm SMD crystal oscillator. p.1: frequency range 0.625-200 MHz, supply voltage 3.135-3.465 V, CMOS output (15 pF). p.3 Options and Part Identification: -L = -40 to +85 C, -C = +-50 ppm, -T = 1000 pcs/reel. p.5: pins 1 Tri-State (STBY), 2 GND/Case, 3 Output, 4 Vdd. p.2 Tri-state function (Stand-by): pin 1 low = output high impedance; high or open = output active.

ECS datasheets/osc/ECS-TXO-32CSMV.pdf: clipped sine wave TCXO, MultiVolt, 3.2 x 2.5 x 1.2 mm ceramic package. p.1: frequency range 10.000-52.000 MHz, input voltage VDD 1.7-3.465 V, output clipped sine wave 0.8 V p-p min into 10 kOhm // 10 pF (modelled as a toggling output, as the library's other ECS TCXOs). p.2: pin connections #1 Ground, #2 Ground, #3 Output, #4 VDD; no enable or standby pin. Part number ECS-TXO-32CSMV-<frequency code>-<stability><temperature>-TR; 260 = 26.000 MHz, A = +-0.5 ppm, N = -40 to +85 C.

Epson datasheets/osc/SG-210STF_en.pdf: crystal oscillator (SPXO), CMOS output, 2.5 x 2.0 mm. p.1: output frequency 1.2-75 MHz (27 MHz is a standard frequency), supply voltage 1.60-3.63 V for 1.2-60 MHz (1.71-3.63 V above 60 MHz at +85 C), CMOS load 15 pF. p.2 Pin Map: 1 ST (HIGH or open = oscillation, output enabled; LOW = oscillation stop, output high impedance), 2 GND, 3 OUT, 4 VCC. The orderable name SG-210STF 27.0000ML5 is model SG-210STF, 27.0000 MHz, tolerance L (+-50 ppm, -40 to +85 C); the last digit is the packing.

Kyocera datasheets/osc/clock_mcz_x_e.pdf (Clock MC-Z series, X type): CMOS clock oscillator for automotive (AEC-Q100/200), 2.0 x 1.6 mm. p.2: output frequency range 0.5-170 MHz, supply voltage 1.71-3.63 V, CMOS load 15 pF; How to Order MC2016Z <frequency> C (CMOS) 1 (1.8/2.5/3.3 V) <tolerance code> X (45/55 %) SH; tolerance code 9 = +-30 ppm, -40 to +125 C. p.1 Pad Connections: #1 Stand-by Function, #2 Case GND, #3 Output, #4 Vcc; Stand-by Function: pad 1 open or H = active, L = High Z (no oscillation).

Microchip datasheets/osc/DSC1001-3-4-1-8V-3-3V-Low-Power-Precision-CMOS-Oscillator-DS20005529.pdf (DS20005529F): MEMS CMOS oscillator. p.1: frequency range 1-150 MHz; p.3 Recommended Operating Conditions: supply voltage 1.7-3.6 V, load 15 pF. p.7 Table 2-1: pins 1 STANDBY#, 2 GND, 3 OUT, 4 VDD. p.9 Standby Function: STANDBY# high (or open, internal pull-up) = output on, low = standby, output disabled. p.29 Product Identification System: DSC1001 B (4-lead 5.0 x 3.2 mm VDFN) I (-40 to +85 C) 1 (+-50 ppm) -050.0000 (50 MHz).

Würth Elektronik datasheets/osc/830208220401.pdf (IQXO-791, AKA LFSPXO082204): 2.5 x 2.0 mm oscillator in a ceramic package with a metal lid (p.1). The datasheet covers this one part: frequency 20.0 MHz, supply voltage 3.3 V +-10 %, CMOS output, 15 pF (p.2). p.1 pad connections: 1 Enable/Disable, 2 GND, 3 Output, 4 +Vs. p.2 Output Control: logic 1 (70 % Vs or more) or no connection on pad 1 enables the output; logic 0 (30 % Vs or less) disables it, output high impedance.
